page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred headings and short rule-like paragraphs; running head at top centre; no margin notes; faint show-through of the reverse page in the background, not transcribed; catchword line "Cap. XIV." at foot centre.

main_text.p: Veritatem impense adamare, & perpetuo studio prosequi.
main_text.head: Quarta.
main_text.p: Toto animo in modestiam & humilitatem incumbere.
main_text.head: Quinta.
main_text.p: Ponere animum & curam in methodo & ordine accurato.
main_text.head: Sexta.
main_text.p: Fouere & retinere modestiam ac prudentem iudicandi libertatem
main_text.head: Septima.
main_text.p: Studere vtilitati & vero vsui, non otiosa futilitati.
main_text.head: Octaua.
Nona.
Decima.
Vndecima.
Duodecima.

page.notes: The running head is set in spaced capitals. Headings "Quarta." through "Duodecima." are ordinal labels in the printed ordinal series and are given level 2 for consistency. The catchword "Cap. XIV." is the chapter reference at the foot. Show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
